To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we identified 5 patients with HPS-1, HPS-3 and HPS-4 and 4 patients with OCA1 in Chinese children presenting with oculocoutaneous albinism, easy bruisability and absent dense granules in platelets.
we identified eight Chinese children, aged 3 to 10 years, with oculocoutaneous albinism who were evaluated for bruising at a single center, and we determined their genotypes and phenotypes.
the etiologies of oculocoutaneous albinism (OCA) and easy bruisibility in Chinese children are diverse and include Hermansky-Podlak syndrome (HSP), and non-syndomimic OCA.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the genetic diagnosis of Chinese children with oculocoutaneous albinism, easy bruising and pigmentation defects.
the clinical and genetic features of oculocoutaneous albinism, which is important to understand the etiology of albinism.
the genetic and phenotypic characterization of Chinese patients with pigmentation defects.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the clinical presentation of easy bruising and hypopigmentation in children of Chinese descent may be due to either HPS or non-syndromatic oculocutancous albinism.

the presence of hypopigmentation and easy bruisabilty in children should raise the suspicion for oculocutaneos albinism and HPS.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have identified a novel HPS-4 variant in a patient of Chinese ancestry, and that the clinical features of HPS and OCA are similar, including hypopigmentation and easy bruisablity.
the clinical presentation of oculocuteous albinism and HPS may be similar, and genetic testing is important to distinguish the two conditions.
we have found that HPS is a common cause of oculocuteraneous albinism with easy bruising in the Chinese population.

genetic testing is essential in establishing the correct diagnosis in children with oculocustaneous albinism, and in determining whether they have HPS or Oculocutaneous Albinism.
